# awscc_route53_record_set_protection (Data Source)

Data Source schema for AWS::Route53::RecordSetProtection



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) Uniquely identifies the resource.

### Read-Only

- `comment` (String) A comment that describes the protection.
- `hosted_zone_id` (String) The ID of the hosted zone that contains the record set to protect.
- `record_name` (String) The name of the record set to protect.
- `record_type` (String) The DNS record type of the record set to protect.
